The task was to convert the Cambridge Dictionary homepage from English (UK) to Deutsch.

The screenshot shows the Cambridge Dictionary interface displayed in German, including:

- The language selector at the top right showing “Deutsch”
- German navigation/search text such as “Suchen Englisch”
- The German homepage heading “Erkunden Sie Cambridge Dictionary”
- Other German interface labels such as “Übersetzungswörterbücher” and “Einloggen / Anmelden”

This aligns with the requested conversion of the homepage language to Deutsch.

Verdict: SUCCESS
